dispositions.topic_text: Whether pre-export room-name correction is an exception to room-name immutability
dispositions.reason: R0-10 binds a room in Registry: once stored there it is never renamed or removed. The correction R0-96 asks is made before the export, in the legacy v1 instance on the VPS, which 'stand[s] outside this document's guarantees' (Actors, Legacy instances; R0-79); no room of Registry is renamed, and the import stores the names it is given (A16). The two rules bind different stores at different times and do not meet.

dispositions.topic_text: Whether archived source projects may be modified for migration
dispositions.reason: R0-12 binds a project in Registry: an archived project there cannot be corrected. Correcting a room name of an archived project on the VPS before the export is an act in the legacy v1 instance, outside this document's guarantees (Actors, Legacy instances; R0-79), as R0-96 places it; the project arrives in Registry already with that name, and R0-85 is the one moment Registry itself sets an archived project's names.
